Abstract Base Class for slurmpilot Scheduler Backends

Source: R/backend_base.R
SlurmBackend.Rd

Defines the pluggable R6 interface implemented by MockSlurmBackend and SlurmSshBackend. Custom HPC scheduler adapters (e.g., PBS/Torque, LSF, or cloud batch APIs) can subclass SlurmBackend and override submit(), status(), retry(), cancel(), logs(), and collect().

Public fields

name

Character identifier of the backend implementation.

SlurmBackend$retry()

Surgically retry failed/cancelled chunks without rerunning completed ones.

Usage

Arguments

job

A slurmpilot_job handle.

Optional integer vector of chunk IDs to retry (defaults to all retryable chunks).

Returns

Updated slurmpilot_job handle.

SlurmBackend$wait()

Block until a job reaches a terminal state or timeout elapses.

Usage

SlurmBackend$wait(job, timeout = Inf, poll_interval = 0.2, progress = FALSE)

Arguments

job

A slurmpilot_job handle.

timeout

Maximum wait time in seconds. Default Inf.

poll_interval

Polling cadence in seconds. Default 0.2.

progress

Logical; emit periodic progress updates. Default FALSE.

Returns

Terminal (or latest on timeout) slurmpilot_status object.
